arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: General Clement argued the Court previously upheld similar restrictions in McConnell.
Mr. Bopp argued the government contradicts its own expert testimony.
Justice Ginsburg asked about other issue ads in the record.
Justice Scalia noted many ads are not issue ads.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The dispute centers on whether electioneering communication rules apply to issue ads. The FEC seeks to enforce these restrictions. Wisconsin Right to Life seeks to broadcast ads without following them.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This case defines the boundary between political speech and campaign finance regulation. It determines how groups discuss policy during election seasons. It shapes the scope of First Amendment protections for advocacy groups.
